experiment.source:
make_notice() {
  seats=0
  while IFS= read -r row || test -n "$row"; do
    case "$row" in
      [1-9]) seats=$((seats + row)) ;;
      *) printf 'Room entry needs review.\n' >&2; return 2 ;;
    esac
  done < "rooms.txt"
  if test "$seats" -gt 8; then
    printf 'Room limit exceeded.\n' >&2
    return 2
  fi
  printf 'Seats requested: %s\n' "$seats"
}
mode=publish
notice=$(make_notice) || exit 2
if test "$mode" = publish; then
  printf '%s\n' "$notice" > "room-notice.txt"
  printf 'Saved example notice.\n'
else
  printf '%s\n' "$notice"
fi
